$comment: +++===+++ 2026-11-01 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-144. Licence policy (owner decisions of 2026-11-01, docs/security/security-baseline.md §7), checked by scripts/dev/licences.py (`pnpm security:licences`, part of check-all). `allowed`: MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0 and PostgreSQL, and the permissive licences the owner counts with them; an expression passes when it is allowed as a whole (one side of OR, both sides of AND). Everything else is an exception for named packages: `shipped: false` means tooling only (build, tests, linters) and fails once the package reaches the app; an exception nothing matches any more fails as well.

exceptions.reason: The PostgreSQL driver of the server (psycopg, psycopg-binary, psycopg-pool); procrastinate, the job queue, works only with psycopg 3. Used unmodified as a separately installed library, which the LGPL permits in an Apache-2.0 project. Owner, 2026-11-01.
Development only: comes with pip-audit (dependency audit). Owner, 2026-11-01: MPL allowed in tooling that never ships, never as a dependency of the app.
Development only: comes with mypy. Owner, 2026-11-01: MPL allowed in tooling that never ships.
Build only: the CSS engine of Tailwind CSS 4 (lightningcss and its platform package); the CSS it writes is ours. Owner, 2026-11-01: MPL allowed in tooling that never ships.
The Inter font of the web app (SIL Open Font License, made for fonts bundled with software). Owner, 2026-11-01: OFL allowed for fonts.
Build only: browser support data for the CSS and JavaScript build tools. Owner, 2026-11-01: CC-BY allowed for data used at build time.
